# Merge

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Merge`](gmeow-Merge.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Merge>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The event of merging one branch of development into another — an activity with a merge-base commit, a source branch or ref, a target branch, and a resulting merge commit. The event type is [`gmeow:eventTypeMerge`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeMerge.md).
